messages:
incident-bot: HIGH — Canary: 3/5 encoder-v2 pods CrashLoopBackOff in us-west-2, error rate spiking for /encode endpoint :rotating_light:

emily: paging oncall (that's me) — I'm seeing 502/500s from the gateway, rolling canary failing health checks

emily: @ryan can you check HPA + node pressure? nina can you look at sidecar change from the release?

ryan: looking now. initial glance: scheduler preempted 2 pods on node ip-10-0-5-12, CPU pressure high, pods got evicted then restarted, readiness probe timeouts after restart

nina: the new canary image swapped the sidecar to debug-image:latest via feature flag. sidecar startup is ~45s now because it mounts a large volume and runs init tasks. readinessProbe is 10s period, fail threshold 3 -> too aggressive

sara: customer-impact: increased 500s for embedding requests from a few customers in us-west-2, about 8% of traffic hitting canary route (canary weight 10%)

emily: ops-bot, can you show recent deploy history for svc/encoder?

ops-bot: recent deploys for svc/encoder:
- 2026-02-24T12:05:14Z deploy v2.3.0 (canary) via deploy-bot by @nina
- 2026-02-24T11:10:01Z deploy v2.2.9 (stable)

ryan: HPA config looks suspect: targetCPUUtilizationPercentage set to 5 (not 50) in canary manifest -> scale-down thrash under transient pressure. that explains rapid term+recreate churn

emily: wow that's a bad typo. so we have 2 issues: sidecar longer init + aggressive HPA scale-down preempting pods -> probe race

nina: confirm: image tag changed in featureflag-service -> flagged on in rollout config. we can flip the flag to disable debug sidecar immediately

emily: short mitigation plan:
1) flip feature flag to disable debug sidecar (nina)
2) bump readinessProbe period to 30s on canary via psuedo-rollout tweak (ryan) OR rollback to v2.2.9 (recommended)
3) pause canary routing (deploy-bot)
4) notify customers + incident postmortem (sara)

nina: flipping flag now -> featureflag svc responded OK :white_check_mark:

nina: confirm sidecar not injected on newly created pod (watching pod  encoder-canary-7f4b)

ryan: I'm applying a quick HPA patch to set targetCPU to 50 (kubectl apply -f -):
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 50
```
applying... returned OK

ops-bot: deploy-bot: pause canary routing for svc/encoder — command: `deploy pause --service=svc/encoder --canary`

deploy-bot: canary routing paused, traffic routed to stable pool (v2.2.9) :arrow_left:

emily: good. are new pods stabilizing?

ryan: new pods launching with previous behavior, no init hang. readiness now passing. CPU stable. no more CrashLoopBackOffs in the last 2 mins

sara: customer-impact update: error rate back down to baseline for impacted customers, will send short incident notice to customers affected by elevated 5xx between 12:06-12:23 PST

emily: oncall handoff: @ryan please take over incident for postmortem and follow-ups (flag origin, deploy guardrails). handing off now. I'm going to update the incidents channel and slack oncall doc

ryan: taking it. I'll open a Jira for a deploy validation check (HPA sanity check + feature flag injection test), and follow up on gating for sidecar changes.

nina: I'll revert the feature-flag change in the commit history and add an automated smoke test for sidecar injection time > 20s should block rollout

ops-bot: incident-bot: incident marked mitigated by emily at 2026-02-24T12:23:40Z — impact contained, rollback not required after flag flip + HPA patch

emily: final notes: root cause = combo of 1) feature-flagged sidecar with long init time and 2) HPA typo (5% vs 50%) causing scale thrash. action items assigned to @nina (smoke tests + flag checklist), @ryan (deploy sanity checks + HPA lint), @sara (customer comms).

sara: will draft customer note now and link to postmortem when ready :pencil:

ryan: will run a postmortem draft tomorrow, include timeline + suggested deploy gating rules. removing oncall pager.

emily: thanks all :heart:
